angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 973,019 km at 48.41 pc = 0.27 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 20.6580 +/- 0.0246 mas (same row, RUWE 1.04): 48.41 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 1.399 (1.371 to 1.427) from Gaia DR3 FLAME (Creevey et al. 2023, A&A 674, A26; astrophysical_parameters of the same source): 973,019 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 1.064 (1.024 to 1.104) from Gaia DR3 FLAME (Creevey et al. 2023, A&A 674, A26; astrophysical_parameters of the same source); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 5926 +/- 1 K from Andrae et al. (2023), A&A 674, A27 (Gaia DR3 GSP-Phot), astrophysical_parameters of Gaia DR3 5965406010180880640: teff_gspphot 5925.999 K (16th-84th percentiles 5925.0654-5926.998), the temperature FLAME used (https://doi.org/10.1051/0004-6361/202243462). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Andrae et al. (2023), A&A 674, A27 (Gaia DR3 GSP-Phot), astrophysical_parameters of Gaia DR3 5965406010180880640: teff_gspphot 5925.999 K (16th-84th percentiles 5925.0654-5926.998), the temperature FLAME used (https://doi.org/10.1051/0004-6361/202243462)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/rapeto.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.173, rounded to two decimals
spectralTypeSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 153950 (pscomppars): spectral type F8 V, from Michigan Catalog, Vol. 2 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/1978MSS...C02....0H/abstract)
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 153950 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] -0.01 dex, from Stassun et al. 2017 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2017AJ....153..136S/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 153950 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units 0.34635, from Moutou et al. 2009 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2009A&A...496..513M/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 153950 (pscomppars): age 4.3 Gyr, from Moutou et al. 2009 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2009A&A...496..513M/abstract)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of HD 153950 (pscomppars): projected rotation speed 5 km/s, from Nordstrom et al. 2004 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2004A&A...418..989N/abstract)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from a blackbody at the star's published temperature (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
